event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit

products.product_description: farm to table meals : Lentil and Barley. This is a dried soup/chili mix which contains lentils and barley in a large zip lock plastic bag along with a small zip lock bag of a chili spice packet. The spice packet contains the recalled cumin. Each plastic zip lock bag has a label affixed to it. The outer label is yellow/orange and black and has a tomato drawing on it. Net. WT. 16 oz.
products.code_info: The date of repacking is stamped on the package. Date is stamped on the bottom of the information panel. It contains the three letter abbreviation for the month in capital letters followed by the two digit day and 4 digit year. Example FEB 02 2015.
products.reason_for_recall: Food for Lane County received and repackaged a product containing cumin which is being recalled due to the potential of being contaminated with peanut protein.
